width_guard.result: No overflow; complete inclusive last-word range must remain in one cache line, with word alignment and distinct full physical line tags.

acceptance_and_ownership: s_awready, s_arready and IDLE AW branch all use cache_prefer_read. Neither request can be accepted while INIT/busy/flush; only one acceptance occurs.
Absent feature or REGISTER_READ_LOOKUP=0 gives constant false preference and exact original arbitration.

Accepted AW remains owned through W commits. Current unaccepted AW may be bypassed only when its complete line is disjoint from the read line; same-line different-word and cross-line cases retain AW priority.
REGISTER_READ_LOOKUP=1 enters R_ACCEPT after capturing AR. Data/meta/victim addresses then use owned addr; speculative IDLE AW/hot addresses are never consumed as read results.
Dirty same-set/different-tag eviction is safe because read ownership covers replacement/writeback/fill; posted-write fill hazards remain active until downstream B.

Depth queue tag coverage is continuous through req/stage, delayed pending entry, array and pop. On pop edge the old tag still blocks; afterward current AW or accepted cache ownership covers the write. A held depth AR stalls fragment production, so no older same-line write appears without prior coverage.
Full fence/flip/clear/idle ownership barriers, blend admission, early-restart snoop/kill logic, cache flush and split soft/bus reset behavior are unchanged.

observer.verdict: v3 chooses actual gate wire if present; otherwise reconstructs pending+valid FIFO tag conflict and conservative local holding registers. wc_busy omission is valid for the bound WRITE_COMBINE=0 model. Depth_psram_ar_only and depth drain diagnostics use actual gate. Command barriers remain full drain.
observer.scope: Reconstruction assumes this bound16-entry FIFO/Z8/WC0 configuration; not a generic guarantee for other parameters.

validation_scope: Source/invariant review, complete offset+len guard enumeration, and frozen-model hash binding. Directed integration tests/native oracle are owned and reported separately; this report makes no measured performance, ALM, fit or timing claim.
